senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Japheth, one of the sons of Noah, progenitor of the Aryan races (Greeks, Persians &c.).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36:8">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:27">Gen. IX, 27</cite>) <he>זה כורש</he> that is Cyrus (the Persians).
<cite ref="Genesis 9:27">Ib.</cite> <he>יהיו … בלשונו של י׳</he> the words of the Law shall be recited in the language of J. (Greek).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 35:1">Pesik. R. s. 35</cite> <he>כורש</he> … <he>שהוא מזרעו של י׳</he> Cyrus … who is a descendant of J.
